intent: Per our change management procedure, execute a progressive rollout for the internet slice: ramp AMBR from the current level (20 Mbps) to the target (60 Mbps) in three equal incremental stages of 33% each (approximately 26 Mbps, 40 Mbps, then 60 Mbps). After each stage, verify with the KPI analyzer that ambr_dl_mean reflects the change before proceeding to the next increment.
